title: [3.13] gh-157335: Fix out-of-bounds write in mmap.mmap.__setitem__ (#157438)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: the trigger runs on the pinned 3.13.7 ASan build (PYTHONMALLOC=malloc, ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0) and reports ASAN:SEGV in safe_byte_copy (mmapmodule.c:361). Running it is the liveness proof -- a sanitizer report here means the defect is present in this tree.
fidelity: the trigger is upstream's own reproducer from the issue, run through the real interpreter rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it.
allocator_layer: libc malloc (the object never reaches a pymalloc pool)
layer_note: NOT measured as a region -- the buffer IS an mmap mapping (mmapmodule.c), so a write past its end reaches the OS and ASan reports SEGV rather than a heap region. No pymalloc pool is involved in any configuration
status: host oracle measured 2026-10-06 on the pinned ASan build; no arm has been run
